'''Prefid's Belt''' was a [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]] visible in the skies of [[Fedje]]. It included the [[Prefsbelt's sun|star]] of the [[Prefsbelt system/Legends|Prefsbelt system]], which earned its name from a corruption of the original name of the constellation. Prefid's Belt was the refuge of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizens fleeing the theocratic [[Pius Dea]]-controlled Republic in the [[11,600s BBY]], which led to the settlement of [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
